Results show that CDM-processed depth substantially improves success compared to raw depth
(Table 3). Without CDMs, the robot almost entirely fails in Toothpaste-and-Cup and achieves low
success in Stack-Bowls. With CDM-D435, success rates increase markedly across both tasks. More-
over, the CDM-enabled policy generalizes to bowls of unseen sizes, consistently achieving non-zero
success across all four novel sizes, whereas the baseline without CDMs fails completely (Fig. 7).
